bug_summary: In the map-merge loop, the guard that decides whether a freshly deserialized value is written back into the map was changed from a reference-inequality check against the previous value to a plain null check on the new value. Consequently, when a JSON null is deserialized for a key that already holds a non-null value, the existing entry is silently kept instead of being replaced with null. All non-null replacements, appends, and the absent-key cases behave exactly as before.
